description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that acts as an interface for logging in an Android application. It wraps around Android's native Log utility, allowing chaining and flexible log message handling, and supports different log levels such as VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, and ASSERT.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class that provides static methods for logging messages at various levels, wrapping Android's native Log functionalities and supporting chaining of LogNode objects for custom log handling.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the linked list that handles log messaging.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log messages will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE priority.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG priority.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO priority.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN priority.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR priority.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT priority.
